# NAM QMS

> NAM QMS (NAM Quality Management Systems) is a Uganda-based ISO training and implementation consultancy. Training courses are for individuals and are booked on each course page. Implementation and consulting are for organisations and institutions and are quoted after a free gap analysis. NAM QMS is not a certification body and does not issue ISO certificates.

## Certification readiness and implementation for organisations
These pages are for organisations. Implementation is quoted. They are not the open training courses.
- [ISO certification in Uganda](https://www.amqualitysystems.com/iso-certification-uganda): hub comparing the standards
- [ISO 9001 certification in Uganda](https://www.amqualitysystems.com/iso-9001-certification-uganda)
- [ISO 14001 certification in Uganda](https://www.amqualitysystems.com/iso-14001-certification-uganda)
- [ISO 27001 certification in Uganda](https://www.amqualitysystems.com/iso-27001-certification-uganda)

- [ISO 13485 certification in Uganda](https://www.amqualitysystems.com/iso-13485-certification-uganda)
- [ISO 42001 certification in Uganda](https://www.amqualitysystems.com/iso-42001-certification-uganda)
- [Internal audit implementation for organisations](https://www.amqualitysystems.com/internal-audit-training)
- [ISO 9001 implementation consulting](https://www.amqualitysystems.com/certifications/iso-9001)
